description: Most dated BFHR local actions (11–19 Oct) lack individual simultaneous crowd counts. Its monthly aggregate 19 demonstrations and 2 vigils across 16 areas, and Al-Wefaq monthly aggregates, cannot be apportioned to individual events. All such candidates remain pending_threshold.
required_followup: Seek contemporaneous event-specific reports, images with defensible counts, or independent attendance estimates for each candidate.

description: For 4 Oct Diraz, opened sources describe a post-prayer mass protest focused on Nasrallah’s assassination and slogans against Israeli actions; they do not clearly establish that demonstrators demanded action of Bahrain’s own state. Candidate remains pending_state_target.
required_followup: Find an event-specific source attributing a Bahrain-state demand to participants, not merely state restrictions as surrounding context.

description: BFHR’s October table is retrospective and names localities/dates but does not establish whether paired-locality rows were jointly organized or separate simultaneous gatherings. No verified national organizer joins these local actions.
required_followup: Check contemporary local sources and organizers; keep locality-specific records separate unless national coordination is evidenced.
